# Vacancy research: 380 7th St, Oakland

**APN:** 001-0193-026-00 (normalized queue APN: `001019302600`)  
**Research date:** 2026-10-15  
**Verdict:** unknown (confidence 0.25)  
**Vacancy start / duration:** undetermined; no dated vacancy evidence found.

## Evidence

- Zillow describes the subject as a 3,016 sq ft, 8-bedroom, 4-bath single-family home built in 1926. It is marked off market, meaning it is not listed on Zillow for sale or rent. That does not show whether anyone occupies it. [Zillow property page](https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/380-7th-St-Oakland-CA-94607/152719244_zpid/)
- Oakland's FY 2025-26 preliminary assessment roll matches the address to APN 001 019302600. It confirms parcel identity, not current use or occupancy. [Oakland Legistar assessment roll](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=DE9D9D0B-4771-4D9D-8F7E-B529062A531F&ID=15191265&M=F)
- The Alameda County Assessor-hosted December 2023 closed-business-account list includes a lessor business at 380 7TH ST with closure date 12/31/2022. A business account closure is not evidence that the dwelling became vacant. [Closed business accounts PDF](https://cao-94612.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/documents/Closed-Business-Accounts-Dec-2023.pdf)
- Oakland provides an Accela complaint lookup by address, but the public page itself contains no subject-specific result. [Oakland complaint-status lookup instructions](https://www.oaklandca.gov/Planning-Building/Code-Enforcement-Services/Check-Status-of-Your-Property-Complaint)

## Assessment

The available address-specific evidence confirms a residential parcel but supplies no reliable current occupancy signal, utility shutoff, vacancy-tax record, dated imagery showing prolonged vacancy, or subject-specific code complaint. No vacancy start date or duration can be supported. Keep the verdict unknown pending stronger evidence.
